launch_product_configuration.reason: Launch keeps one deterministic buy option per non-consumable so the client can use the plugin's default purchase option path without offer-selection ambiguity.

purchase_state_policy.PENDING: never_grant; retain prior verified offline cache only

backend_validation_requirements: exactly one expected launch product line item is present
returned productId equals the claimed configured product_id
purchase token has not granted a different product
acknowledgement state is checked before acknowledgement
backend_processing_order: fetch authoritative ProductPurchaseV2 by packageName and purchaseToken
validate purchase state and exact expected product line item before any token binding
bind sha256(purchase_token) to the authoritative package/product transactionally
record the minimum non-secret processing state without persisting the raw purchase token or order id
acknowledge the non-consumable server-side when acknowledgement is pending
refetch ProductPurchaseV2 and confirm PURCHASED plus ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_STATE_ACKNOWLEDGED
return owned=true with the exact verification_request_id only after the authoritative record is safe

completion_requirements: install and pin the exact plugin release in the project
configure both Play Console non-consumable products with one launch buy option each and no launch offers/rent/preorder/bundles
execute the reference backend static/unit gates on a functioning runner
deploy the reviewed purchase verification backend and freeze its public HTTPS endpoint, attached service identity and abuse/rate-limit controls
enable and authorize the Google Play Android Developer API for the dedicated backend service identity without committing a service-account key
configure Firestore transactional token-product binding and freeze purchase-record retention/deletion with 12.3
verify purchaseToken with purchases.productsv2.getproductpurchasev2 before grant
validate the authoritative product line item against the claimed configured product
acknowledge verified non-consumables server-side and return only after acknowledgement is confirmed by refetch
preserve exact verification_request_id correlation across asynchronous responses
pass pending-purchase no-grant, overlap and stale-response isolation tests
pass purchase, restore, refund/revocation and reinstall/restore tests on Play test track
prove previously verified offline entitlement cache survives temporary store/backend outage
repeat 12.3 privacy/Data Safety audit after final billing integration
